questions.prompt: Two mouse epithelial cultures show an early STAT5 phosphorylation peak. Only the matrix-supported culture later maintains STAT5 activation and appreciable casein expression. Which measurement best distinguishes the proposed mechanism?

options.explanation: Receptor abundance alone does not measure signal persistence or casein expression.

questions.subject: histology

questions.title: Link organelles to secretion
questions.prompt: An alveolar epithelial cell has developed rough ER and Golgi, protein-containing secretory vesicles and separate cytoplasmic lipid droplets. Which model best connects these observations?

questions.subject: histology

questions.title: Separate ejection from production
questions.prompt: In an experimental gland, secretion is present in the luminal compartment but delivery is impaired. Which mechanism should be evaluated independently of protein synthesis?

options.text: Protein synthesis on rough-ER-associated ribosomes
options.explanation: This addresses production; the question asks about movement independently of biosynthesis.

options.text: Golgi packaging of protein cargo
options.explanation: Packaging contributes to secretion within the luminal cell, not the contractile ejection mechanism.

options.text: The amount of collagen in one sampled interlobular field
options.explanation: Stromal appearance alone does not test myoepithelial contraction or effective ductal flow.

options.text: Oxytocin-linked myoepithelial contraction and subsequent ductal flow
options.explanation: Production, release and tissue-level movement are connected but distinct processes.

questions.subject: histology

questions.title: Interpret a rescue
questions.prompt: Oxytocin administration restores milk ejection in oxytocin-null mice. What does the rescue most directly support?

options.text: A universal self-treatment protocol for human feeding difficulties
options.explanation: The animal rescue is not a human treatment instruction.

questions.subject: histology

questions.title: Choose a ductal model
questions.prompt: A human ultrasound study finds compressible branching ducts and no conventional sac-like lactiferous sinuses. Which teaching diagram is most faithful to that observation?

options.text: Exactly twenty identical reservoirs in every breast
options.explanation: The data do not establish that universal number or structure.

options.text: A branching transport pathway without adding obligatory large subareolar sacs
options.explanation: The diagram should retain the measured arrangement and avoid imposing an unobserved reservoir.

options.text: A gland with no ducts because sacs were absent
options.explanation: Absence of conventional sinuses does not mean absence of conducting ducts.

options.explanation: The reported ducts branched; this simplification contradicts the observation.

questions.subject: histology

questions.title: Distinguish kinds of involution
questions.prompt: A biopsy image used in an age-related TDLU study is relabeled as early post-weaning tissue. Which information is missing for that relabeling?

options.text: A brighter segmentation-overlay color
options.explanation: A display choice cannot establish the specimen time course.

options.text: An increased number of image pixels
options.explanation: Resolution alone does not provide clinical or temporal history.

options.explanation: A similar word for regression does not make the two biological contexts equivalent.

options.text: A second copy of the same image with a new filename
options.explanation: Renaming or duplication supplies no additional specimen evidence.

questions.subject: histology

questions.title: Trace reuptake
questions.prompt: During experimentally induced mouse involution, intracellular lipid bodies retain evidence of a membrane coating acquired during secretion. Which interpretation does that finding support?

options.text: Every lipid body was newly synthesized inside the cell after weaning
options.explanation: The coating supports a different route for the observed structures.

options.explanation: It indicates cargo history, not a fibroblast phenotype.

options.explanation: The study combines uptake evidence with lysosomal localization.

options.text: Previously secreted milk-fat globules have been taken back into epithelial cells
options.explanation: The coating helps distinguish luminally derived globules from unsecreted intracellular droplets.

questions.subject: histology

questions.title: Keep model contexts separate
questions.prompt: A study combines mouse involution tissue, mammary cell cultures and isolated lysosome assays. Which synthesis preserves the evidence?

options.text: The experiments support linked steps of an uptake–lysosomal processing–cell death mechanism in their defined contexts

questions.subject: histology

questions.title: Connect developmental compartments
questions.prompt: Which developmental explanation best connects the early mammary bud to adult tissue organization?

options.explanation: This confuses epithelial origin with surrounding matrix.

options.explanation: The epithelial and surrounding connective-tissue contributions interact without being the same compartment.

options.text: A mouse embryonic labeling day is automatically the same numbered human gestational week

questions.subject: histology

questions.title: Read a segmented image
questions.prompt: A research figure shows H&E on the left and bright computer-generated compartment colors on the right. What should a student infer from the colors?

options.explanation: The colors were generated computationally.

options.explanation: Columnar epithelium occurs at several sites and cannot identify the organ alone.
